questions.question: Which expression compares the characters in two Strings a and b?
questions.explanation: equals compares String content; == compares reference identity.

questions.question: Which loop best expresses visiting every index of an array exactly once?
options: A for loop from 0 while i < length
questions.explanation: The initial index, boundary, and update are all explicit in a for loop.

questions.question: When hasNextInt() is false, why should the program call next()?
options: To consume the bad token so validation can progress
To turn it into an int
To skip the next valid line
questions.explanation: Without consuming the invalid token, the loop observes the same token forever.

questions.question: What commonly remains after Scanner.nextInt()?
questions.explanation: nextInt consumes the numeric token but not the rest of its line.
